# .github/

**GitHub platform config** (not application source). This folder cannot live under `docs/` or `web/` — GitHub only reads workflows and templates here.

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| [`workflows/pages.yml`](workflows/pages.yml) | Deploy `web/` to GitHub Pages |
| [`ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) | Issue forms |
| [`profile/README.md`](profile/README.md) | Organization profile on github.com/object-digital-passport |
